edit.why: M3 in the original is diode-connected: its drain (bottom pin) goes to node 2 and its gate, not to VDD
M4 in the original has its drain (bottom pin) on node 3, not on VDD
M1 in the original has its source on the tail node 4
The body of M1 in the original goes to the ground symbol in the middle
The body of M2 in the original goes to the ground symbol in the middle
The middle symbol is a ground symbol, not a voltage source
